answer_1.quote: SceneGenAgent translates scene descriptions into C# code, leveraging APIs provided by Tecnomatix ... and executes the code to render the corresponding scene.
answer_1.outputs: C# code and rendered industrial scenes

answer_4.quote: Our evaluation team consists of 3 members with expertise in industrial scenes and proficiency in the Process Simulate software. Due to the labor-intensive nature of the manual inspection, we sample 5 times for each description ... Each evaluator reviews at least one of the five samples of each description to minimize the influence of subjectivity.
answer_4.guideline: carefully comparing each scene against its description
